Background

Slotkin is a former CIA analyst and Pentagon official who represented a Michigan House district from 2019 to 2025. She was elected to the Senate in 2024.

Outlook

New to the board this week. Slotkin told reporters in Denver she is seriously considering a run, and she has said she will not vote for Schumer as leader. She tied for 16th in the Crooked Con straw poll and is under 1 percent in prediction markets, so she starts near the bottom.
